summary: Lunai Bioworks filed an 8-K announcing a postponement of its Special Meeting of Stockholders from May 4 to May 8, 2026, to allow additional time for voting and to achieve a quorum. The postponement addresses broker discretionary voting timing under NYSE Rule 452. No material transaction or corporate event is disclosed; it is a procedural adjournment. This is a routine meeting logistics filing, not a special situation.
